summary: Manage your team of AI agents by voice, from anywhere Discussion | Link
content: Openbase lets you manage a team of AI coding agents by voice, from anywhere; no screen, no desk. AI agents can work async, but supervising them still pulls you back to a laptop. OpenBase fixes that. Dispatch tasks, steer agents mid-work, and approve changes just by talking. The agents write code, control your computer, open PRs, commit and push; you stay in control from your phone. Works across providers and syncs to your machine, so you pick up at your desk right where you left off.
chineseSummary: 随时随地通过语音管理您的 AI 代理团队关联
chineseContent: Openbase 可让您随时随地通过语音管理 AI 编码代理团队；没有屏幕，没有桌子。人工智能代理可以异步工作，但监督它们仍然会让你回到笔记本电脑上。 OpenBase 解决了这个问题。只需通过谈话即可分配任务、指导代理工作并批准变更。代理编写代码、控制您的计算机、打开 PR、提交和推送；您可以通过手机进行控制。跨提供商工作并同步到您的计算机，因此您可以在办公桌上从上次停下的地方继续。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
